title: Align Telegram document file-error classification for Windows symlink loops and access refusals
outcome: Return and document consistent typed refusals for Telegram document path errors, including Windows ERROR_CANT_RESOLVE_FILENAME, without treating caller file conditions as unexpected backend failures.
acceptance: A Windows symlink loop is reported with the documented typed refusal and is covered by a real filesystem loop test with symlink privilege available.
PermissionDenied handling is explicitly decided and the documented error table matches the chosen behavior on supported platforms.
